description: Every corpus identifier used anywhere in this project's analysis scripts, resolved to the independent patient/animal group it actually belongs to. Two identifiers collide into one group only on concrete evidence -- a loader path constant proving they open the same directory, or a verified cross-corpus patient match -- never on name similarity. Use src/subject_independence.py:count_independent_groups to count how many independent groups a list of corpus identifiers spans; it raises on any identifier not listed under member_corpus_identifiers below.

groups.basis: config/datasets.json dandi_000469.view_relationship: 'independent, confirmed by all-pairs trial-content fingerprint audit 2026-08-03 (results/patient_identity_audit.json); zero cross-release overlap found'; directory listing of 000469 confirms 21 subjects, none shared with any other registered directory

scripts/run_boran_pipeline.py:32 (BORAN_DIR = dataset_path("dandi_000574")) proves boran and dandi000574_units are two recording views of the same dandi_000574 directory -- boran reads high-gamma field potential, dandi000574_units reads single units, both from the identical 9-patient sub-01..sub-09 population; results/cross_modality_calibration.json patient_overlap (age/sex/pathology triple fingerprint match between ds004752 participants.tsv and DANDI 000574 NWB subject metadata) proves ds004752's first 9 patients (sub-01..sub-09) are the identical DANDI 000574 cohort; ds004752's sub-10..sub-15 are ds004752-only patients not present in dandi_000574, included in this group conservatively because they are never separable from the shared 9 at the corpus-identifier granularity this registry operates on

provenance/dataset_overlap_report.json verified_001187_000673_shared_patients (31 patients, NWB subject-metadata / trial-table-hash cross-match across 37 shared recording sessions); config/datasets.json canonical_view_rule: prefer dandi_001187 for a verified 001187/000673 shared recording, retain dandi_000673 as a linked sensitivity view

config/datasets.json dandi_000004.view_relationship: 'independent recognition-memory corpus'; directory listing of 000004 confirms 59 subjects; no verified or claimed overlap with any other registered corpus anywhere in config/datasets.json or provenance/dataset_overlap_report.json
